about: Answers written to be right or wrong in known ways, each labelled: do the sources the assistant supplies for the question support every claim? Used to calibrate the judge before trusting it.

answers.question: What engine does the Cessna 172S have, and what is its rated power?
answers.answer: The Cessna 172S has a Lycoming IO-360-L2A engine, rated at 180 horsepower.
answers.label: supported

answers.question: What engine does the Cessna 172S have, and what is its rated power?
answers.answer: The Cessna 172S has a Lycoming IO-360-L2A engine, rated at 160 horsepower.
answers.label: unsupported

answers.question: Can we still use the 50-hour allowance in AD 2013-11-11 when a switch reaches 3,000 hours?
answers.answer: No. The 50-hour allowance applied once, when the AD took effect; after that the switch is replaced at 3,000 hours.
answers.label: supported
answers.note: Matches the training deck's speaker notes and the AD's paragraph (g)(6).

answers.question: Can we still use the 50-hour allowance in AD 2013-11-11 when a switch reaches 3,000 hours?
answers.answer: Yes. A switch at 3,000 hours can always run 50 more hours before it must be replaced.
answers.label: unsupported
answers.note: The opposite of the deck's notes.

answers.question: What does AD 2000-04-01 require?
answers.answer: AD 2000-04-01 requires replacing any P/N 83278 oil pressure switch with a P/N 77041 switch.
answers.label: unsupported
answers.note: The part numbers are reversed; every word is in the sources.

answers.question: What must a maintenance record entry contain?
answers.answer: The entry must describe the work, give the date it was completed, and carry the name, signature, and certificate of the person who approved it.
answers.label: unsupported
answers.note: Says the approver's name is required; 43.9(a)(4) asks for their signature, certificate number, and kind of certificate. First labelled supported: the judge's disagreement found the labelling error.

answers.question: How many hours remain before CN-TFE's engine oil pressure switch reaches its limit?
answers.answer: CN-TFE's switch has 39.4 hours left: 3,000 minus (13,520.8 minus 10,560.2).
answers.label: unsupported
answers.note: The right number, but the current hours (13,520.8) are not in the supplied sources.

answers.question: Is CN-TFE's oil pressure switch within the limit of AD 2013-11-11, according to its records?
answers.answer: The records disagree: the fleet register gives 10,560.2 airframe hours at installation and the compliance record 10,650.2, and neither gives the current hours, so they don't establish it.
answers.label: supported
answers.note: States what the supplied records say and what they lack.
